newsitem.title: USA: Horizon may acquire Pacific Rehab.
newsitem.headline: Horizon may acquire Pacific Rehab.

text.p: Pacific Rehabilitation & Sports Medicine Inc said on Wednesday it was in negotiations to be acquired by Horizon/CMS Healthcare Corp at $6.50 cash per share.
In the quarter ended June 30 Pacific Rehab had 8.1 million shares outstanding.
Pacific Rehab said discussions were continuing and no definitive agreement had been reached.
Pacific Rehab provides outpatient physical therapy at 70 clinics in several western and southern states.
Pacific Rehab shares were up 1-1/4 to 5-1/8 in early-afternoon trading following the news.
Shares of Albuquerque, N.M.-based Horizon were unchanged at 10-3/4.
Horizon operates about 95 acute- and subacute-care hospitals in 17 states, and 194 clinics in 21 states. In its fiscal year ended last May 31, the company generated revenues of $1.75 billion.
In 1995 Pacific Rehab generated revnues of $35 million.
